about: Not your traditional Golf game. Humorous destruction and over the top trickshots are the way to score big. Smash up the toilets, make a big mess in the Kitchen, destroy priceless antiques in the Palace.
This is golf played indoors where the more expensive the object the higher its game value.
Destroy as much of the environment as possible, make a big old mess and then blast the ball into the hole with the wildest, most outrageous Trickshot possible.
This is not about golf strokes and Par. This is about who can earn the most Trickshot and $ Damage Score to top the Leaderboard.
Solo, Couch Co-Op, Local and Online Competitive Play all supported. Up to 8 Players.
